title: UK private jet deportation flight cancelled after man swallows vape battery
summary: Egyptian with history of disruptive behaviour was taken to hospital and then returned to detention A Home Office private deportation flight for one man had to be cancelled on Thursday morning after he was able to swallow a lithium vape battery shortly before being taken to the plane. Officials are now investigating the circumstances around the incident. The man, an Egyptian foreign national offender with a history of being disruptive during removal attempts, was due to take a flight from the UK via Albania to Egypt. Continue reading...
